Needs changes before merge.

This is a SAFETY-tier review. The changes affect toolpaths, geometry, and verification without a solid mesh.
I checked the laws from upstream main `acd5b02d3e36a12745b11038012240781129d43c`.
The current diff includes the parent PR #2716, including its UI and process changes.

The pick seeds the slot in the command. The new tests check undo, slot dimensions, named refusals, and moved sketches.
The new contour and slot suites pass. The UI suites and clippy pass.

**Local build and tests**

The trial merge with upstream main failed in these files:

- `crates/app/src/commands/operation/geometry.rs`
- `crates/app/src/project/apply.rs`
- `crates/app/src/project/file.rs`
- `crates/app/tests/model_link.rs`

I aborted the trial merge. All results below are from the PR head, without that merge.
No GitHub runner was used.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` selected the batch plan because geometry changed.
The local build passed. The gate completed all 916 steps: 914 passed and two failed. Clippy passed with `-D warnings`.

| Crate | Tests passed | Failed | Ignored |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| geometry | 165 | 0 | 0 |
| kernel | 70 | 1 | 4 |
| cl | 69 | 0 | 0 |
| tools | 129 | 0 | 0 |
| post | 776 | 0 | 0 |
| sim | 726 | 0 | 4 |
| motion | 1163 | 0 | 22 |
| app | 3951 | 1 | 43 |
| ui | 1389 | 0 | 9 |

The two failed tests are:

- `camcraft-kernel --test step_agreement`: `step_files_agree_or_refuse_by_name`. The fixture `bar_cross_holes.step` has no row.
- `camcraft-app --test feature_edge_g1_join`: `no_pickable_edge_is_a_tangent_piece_of_a_longer_one_in_any_step_fixture`.

```text
crates/kernel/tests/step_agreement.rs:466:5:
assertion `left == right` failed: a fixture has no row, or a row has no fixture - re-triage

crates/app/tests/feature_edge_g1_join.rs:94:5:
tangent pieces of one edge pick apart: [
    "bar_cross_holes.step: 116 pairs, first (97186, 97189)",
]
```

These are failures on the PR head. This review does not identify them as regressions from the slot commit.
Current upstream main has the missing STEP row. The PR body already identifies the feature-edge failure and its upstream fix.
The conflicting combined tree remains unverified.

**Extra suites run**

- Golden reader: `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-app --test slot_dxf_sketch`, run separately after the gate: four passed.
- The changed golden files have one reader: `crates/app/tests/slot_dxf_sketch.rs`.
- The gate also ran `camcraft-kernel --test step_agreement`, `camcraft-kernel --test machining_mesh`, and `camcraft-app --test feature_edge_g1_join` by name.
- `machining_mesh`: seven passed. The other two results are above.

**Mutations and goldens**

I repeated two guard mutations in the review worktree:

| Mutation | Test | Mutated | Restored |
|---|---|---|---|
| M3: disable centerline straightness | `a_bent_short_or_doubled_centerline_is_refused_by_name` | failed as expected | passed |
| M4: disable the centerline ends law | `a_centerline_room_holds_its_two_ends_and_refuses_other_ends` | failed as expected | passed |

Both are motion library tests. Each mutation returned exit 101 from the named assertion. Each restored test returned exit 0.
All temporary changes were restored. The source diff is empty.

No existing golden changed. I checked every line of both new CL goldens: nine slot moves and 406 trochoidal moves.
An additional numeric check sampled each cutting segment and arc sweep against the expected cutter-center stadium.
The maximum center distance from its axis was 3.000 mm for Slot and 3.001 mm for Trochoidal Slot.
The check allowed 0.002 mm for the recorded CL rounding.
No new posted NC sample was checked by hand. The existing post suites ran.

**Requested before merge**

1. Resolve the four merge conflicts at the permitted refresh step. Reconcile the format at `crates/app/src/project/file.rs:153`.
   Both branches use version 73 for different fields. Keep main's protected-feature data and the sketch data during migration.
   Then run the two failed suites and the quick gate on the combined final head. Both failed suites block this review.
2. Add before/after screenshots to the PR body for the UI changes, including `crates/ui/src/egui_app/geo_page.rs:139`.
   The current body has none. Link the images from the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch.
3. Add `Process change: yes` to the PR body. The current diff changes `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md:160`.
   The body currently says no process file changed. The merging session handles `PROCESS_VERSION`.
4. Run the reached heavy lanes on the final head and record their results in the body.
   The geometry and motion changes, including `crates/motion/src/machining2d/slot_room_line.rs:17`, reach the motion and app heavy lanes.
   Use `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` after the refresh. These lanes were not run here and have no results in the body.
   Current upstream `AGENTS.md`, “Heavy lanes at review”, requires them before readiness.

The review state is `needs-rework` and `conflicts`. The PR remains a draft.
A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Please fix ASAP.

This PR has the label `needs-rework`. The open items are in the latest review comment on this PR. Push a fix, or say that you keep this PR. The maintainer asked for this reminder.

Addressed: the four requests of the review of `bd24b9328`. The new head is `e42e408f099ec52667f9d0c13949a4e83571e5ea`.

1. Merge conflicts and the format version.
   - I merged `upstream/main` into the branch (merge commits, no rebase, no force-push).
   - Main uses v73 for `do_not_touch` (#2055). The sketch picks and `chain_overrides` now use v74. A v73 reader refuses them.
   - A v73 file steps up to v74 and keeps its protection.
   - `SetOperationGeometry` keeps the per-chain overrides and main's `do_not_touch` overlap refusal.
   - Main's new code matches `FeatureSel` exhaustively, so I fixed six places that git did not show as conflicts. `Do not touch` refuses a sketch pick by name.
   - New pins: `do_not_touch_refuses_a_sketch_chain_or_layer_by_name`, the v73 step-up in `protected_project_roundtrips_and_refuses_a_future_version`, and the v74 barrier in `layer_and_chain_picks_per_chain_overrides_undo_and_project_v74_roundtrip`.
   - Three mutations: each was red, and each was green when I restored it. The PR body has the table.
   - Quick gate (batch plan) on the combined tree: 997 steps. One step failed: `continuous_4axis_part`, because the example file was at v73. I fixed it, and the `--failed` rerun is green. Clippy is green.
   - `step_agreement` and `feature_edge_g1_join` are green on the combined head.
2. Screenshots. The PR body has before and after screenshots of the Geometry page for 2D Contour and for Slot. They are on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch, folder `2920/`.
3. The PR body has `Process change: yes`. The PR does not change `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`.
4. Heavy lanes. `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` on the final tree: 234 steps, 233 ok.
   - The known-fail markers were red as expected.
   - One step failed: `pocket3d_hsm` `the_users_bore_roughs_adaptive_level_by_level_and_verifies_clean`, with the counts (3158, 3130, 1141).
   - This is the open issue #3050. The same test is red on `main` with the same counts. This PR does not change the adaptive planner or the STEP mesh.

The slot goldens took only main's new `START` line (#2901). The moves did not change.

Please review the new head again.

**Requested before merge**

1. Preserve the resolved cut side when grouping sketches at `crates/app/src/operation/contour_sketch.rs:228`.
   `can_group_natural` accepts outer loops from separate profiles. `Region::new` then reads the inner profile as a hole.
   A local diagnostic test imports two separate circular profiles at (50, 50), with radii 20 and 8 mm.
   Both resolve as `Outside`. With Side Auto and a 4 mm tool, the grouped path has radii 21.99998 and 5.99994 mm.
   The inner path needs a 10 mm radius. Selecting that profile alone gives 9.99995 mm and passes the same assertion.
   Thus the grouped operation cuts the wrong side. The diagnostic test fails on the combined tree.
   Group only when the resulting nesting preserves the resolved sides. Keep entity identity in the parent checks. Add a two-profile test.

2. Key sketch highlights by their placed pose at `crates/ui/src/pick_highlight.rs:83`.
   `view_pose` returns the sketch's local `Location`, so `.or(sketch_pose)` discards its pose on the stock.
   Moving the stock or changing its height leaves the cache key unchanged. The cached highlight stays at its old position.
   Use the placed sketch pose, including its absence when stock is removed. Add stock-change and undo tests for the highlight cache.

3. Declare the v74 format change as breaking at `crates/app/src/project/file.rs:158`.
   Older readers refuse the new files. The title and commits have neither a conventional breaking marker nor a `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer.
   Add the notice required by the review rules and upstream main's “Commits and Releases” law.

4. Record a green result for the reached heavy lanes on the final tree.
   The body's latest result is 234 steps, with 233 passed and one failed in `app heavy: pocket3d_hsm`.
   It attributes that failure to #3050. This review does not call it a regression from this PR.
   However, upstream main's “Heavy lanes at review” law requires a green result before readiness. It gives no baseline-failure exception.
   Run `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` after the corrections. Record the motion and app lane results in the body.
   I did not repeat those release lanes here. The green quick gate does not cover them.

The diagnostic test and its evidence are in `/tmp`, outside the PR tree. No review artifact was committed.
The review state is `needs-rework`. The PR merges cleanly, so the old `conflicts` label can be removed. The PR remains a draft.
A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: findings 1, 2, and 3 from the latest review. The new head is `36b0c6439751dea1016c491a055c7757e66baad5`.

1. Natural contour grouping keeps chains within one profile entity. Parent checks use the entity and chain ID. `separate_nested_profiles_keep_both_outside_contours` pins the 10 and 22 mm cutter radii. Original grouping: red, exit 101. Restored grouping: green.
2. Highlight keys use the placed sketch pose, including its absence without stock. `sketch_highlight_follows_stock_pose_and_height_with_undo` pins movement, height, undo, and redo. `sketch_highlight_disappears_without_stock_and_returns_on_undo` pins removal and undo. Original key: both red, exit 101. Restored key: both green.
3. The PR title has a breaking marker. The fixing commit and PR body have a `BREAKING CHANGE:` notice for v74. Older readers refuse these files.

Quick gate: 998 steps passed. Clippy passed on all eight touched crates with `--all-targets -- -D warnings`.

Finding 4 remains open. The full heavy gate completed: 233 steps passed and one failed. Motion: 34/34 green. App: 198/199 green. `the_users_bore_roughs_adaptive_level_by_level_and_verifies_clean` failed with counts `(3158, 3130, 1141)`. This matches the earlier review result attributed to #3050. The body records this result. The PR stays a draft.

Please review the corrected findings again. No labels or `PROCESS_VERSION` changed. No review artifacts were committed.
